verdict.rationale: None of the first-party docs in the pack publish benchmarks or measured latency or throughput figures. The only reference to measurements is one community comment pointing to third-party hardware latency tests, with no actual numbers given. That is not the product's own documented capability. The other community remarks are subjective impressions of speed, not published measurements.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/throughput numbers backing the terminal's performance claims
